answer: Assign each account a vertex in the attestation graph and run a challenge-response at every epoch boundary: the node seeds one unpredictable task, and full answers must land inside a narrow window. A plume of clone wallets can register cheaply, but replaying the task across all of them needs compute and network capacity per wallet, not per identity. One ember of genuine activity - a hand-timed reply that clears the window - outweighs a hundred scripted duplicates.
